statement: WiiBrew community documentation describes the active 04/05/07 MotionPlus IDs, a status 0x20 disconnect then reconnect on A400F0=55 deactivation, and unsolicited 0x20 on extension changes followed by required 0x12 report-mode reselection. The reviewed pinned WiiBrew records do not establish a universal activation 0x20 pair, an active mode-switch edge count, a physical timing value or integrated Remote Plus status sequence; no negative physical assertion follows.

applicability.revision: Original external MotionPlus and integrated Remote Plus distinguished where possible; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: device. WiiBrew oldid 120079 MotionPlus introductory/activation/deactivation passages and oldid 123257 Wiimote Status Reporting. Reuses wii-gap-wiibrew-motionplus-deactivation and wii-gap-wiibrew-status-20-resend. Source-only; all physical and proposed host experiments not run.
